definition: The index of the style graph: every tradition, family, style and variant, filed from the broadest down to the regional variants a house can actually be built in. Choose one to open its dossier.
basis: The page is the workbench's own, ruled for Phase 14, and no corpus file describes it; what it shows is described where the basis quotes. README.md: "Four ranks — tradition → family → style → variant." and filing "is the drawer a node lives in. It exists for browsing, and it is not lineage" docs/model.md gives the variant as "The regional or period expression at which a kit is actually buildable".

surface.what: Every tradition, family, style and variant, filed broadest first. Open one to read its dossier.
read: The tree follows filing, not descent: each entry sits in one drawer, and its real ancestry is in its dossier.
A variant is where a kit becomes buildable; the broader ranks group and explain.
